g.text: Pad damping, stiffness and width have different effects
Total axial pressing force only · same 1 mm × 10 mm full-width ridge at 100 mm/s
Left: noisy closed-loop tests; damping c in N·s/m. Right: native held-current plant test, 20 N, S=1.4 kg.
